description: Get one Carragent agent by its id (for example collections, scheduling, leads, reviews, report). Use it after list_agents or search_carragent when the user wants the details of one agent. Returns the agent: its summary, when it runs, its steps in order, what waits for the owner, what it never does and the tools it connects to.

lang.description: Language of the text: en, es or fr.

name: get_agent

area.description: The family it belongs to: money, customers, sales or operations.

status.description: live works today; soon is being built.

tools.description: The tools it connects to, or null when there is nothing to connect.

waitsForOwner.description: What waits for the owner's approval.

title: Get one Carragent agent
